items.name: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the gate's verdict
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: R-1/C-1 at commit A (green stub): start-run responded after 19s; status awaiting-verdicts; effects 1-9 stamp,pin,checklist,self-check,fence,regenerate,install,self-check,gate all outcome recorded; gate events [regeneration-cycle/gate-attempt-passed]. Candidate digest sha256:8f337b... matches my own computation of the seam's formula over the fixture files.

items.name: A run identity is started once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: R-10/C-10 failed at the fence (self-check failed); start R-10 of C-2b refused -32000 run-already-started; run-progress lists R-10 once, cycle C-10, still failed.

items.name: A second run is refused while the first awaits its verdicts
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: With R-1/C-1 awaiting verdicts, start R-2/C-2 refused run-in-progress; run-progress R-2 -> null; R-1 still awaiting-verdicts.

items.name: A cycle is run once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: After R-1/C-1 passed, start R-2/C-1 refused cycle-already-run; run-progress R-2 -> null.

items.name: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: start at deadbeef... refused not-a-commit (0.0s); run-progress R-5 -> null; stub builder launch counter stayed 0.

items.name: A run whose context does not respond on its seam is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: Measurement entrypoint exits at once: start refused contexts-not-responding with data.contexts ["measurement"]; R-6 -> null; no builder launch. Variant with measurement absent from LOYLY_CONTEXTS: same refusal naming measurement.

items.name: Each handoff is handed in, unchanged and once, to every consumer, in its producer's order
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: R-1: relayed handoffs in order: scenario-stamped p1,p2 -> measurement; source-cut-pinned p1 -> measurement and -> regeneration-cycle; gate-attempt-passed p1 -> measurement once; all accepted (and after verdicts measurement-filed p1, scoreboard-reported p2 -> regeneration-cycle accepted).

items.name: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: Commit C (spec file with no scenario): checklist effect refused empty-checklist (measurement/derive-checklist); run halted, halt effect checklist, reason refused-before-the-cycle; effects only stamp,pin,checklist (no self-check, no fence).

items.name: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: Commit D (extra untagged scenario): stamp effect recorded (3 scenario-stamped events); run halted at stamp, refused-before-the-cycle, detail names plan identities [01-001 01-002] vs stamp [01-001 01-002 01-003]; only 1 effect (no pin, no checklist).

items.name: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: Self-check exits 1, last line 'golden checklist differs': run failed; cycle failure {stage fence, reason harness-self-check-failed, detail 'golden checklist differs'}; last effect self-check (harness-self-check-failed); no fence or regenerate effect.

items.name: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: Self-check prints 'SKIP bb-tools', exit 0: first self-check effect recorded with harness-self-check-passed whose skipped-checks is ["bb-tools"]; effect detail 'skipped checks: bb-tools'.

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: Commit B (impl, no harness/cycles), fence 'impl harness/cycles': fence effect refused fenced-path-matched-nothing (regeneration-cycle/prove-clean-room); next effect fail-cycle recorded; run failed, cycle at fence for fence-refused; builder launch counter 0.

items.name: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: Commit A holds impl/ and harness/cycles/ (two commits of history); stub builder saw docs/plan/01-booking/spec.feature, harness/config.sh, probe, check, empty impl/; git rev-list --all = 1 commit, no remote; no impl or harness/cycles path in HEAD tree or in rev-list --all --objects.

items.name: Each regenerate launches one builder and waits for it
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: Red-then-green stub: launched exactly twice (regenerate attempt 1, repair attempt 2); launch 1 END 809.40 < launch 2 START 810.36 (epoch s).

items.name: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: Stub copies green candidate and exits 1: regenerate effect recorded with candidate-digest sha256:8f337b... (the green fixture's); run awaits its verdicts.

items.name: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: Stub exits 0 leaving impl empty: no regenerate effect; fail-cycle effect recorded; run failed, cycle at regenerate for candidate-not-regenerated.

items.name: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: Budget regenerate 2 s, stub sleeps 30 s: run responded in 16 s; stub never logged SLEEP-FINISHED/END and no process remained (stopped); run failed, cycle at regenerate for budget.

items.name: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: Grader held port 20601 answering HTTP: gate effects attempt 1 refused seam-answered-before-boot three times, each followed by a recorded gate-refusal effect (gate-attempt-refused); run failed, cycle at gate for infrastructure; candidate start.sh log empty (never started).

items.name: A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: Red-suite candidate, limit 1: gate effect attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-failed reason suite-red; start.sh log empty; run failed, cycle at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted.

items.name: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: Candidate without start.sh, limit 1: gate effect attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-failed reason contract-missing.

items.name: A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: Candidate page without 'sauna', marker sauna, limit 1: gate effect attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-failed reason identity-probe-failed.

items.name: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: Stub leaves green candidate and a background writer that, 0.5 s / 0.2 s after exit, turns impl/test.sh red and adds LATE: builder room ended red with LATE, gate room copy did not; gate attempt 1 gate-attempt-passed; install and regenerate digests both sha256:8f337b... (runs R-22a, R-22b). (A first try whose writer began before the stub exited was a fixture race and is not counted.)

items.name: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: R-14 (first candidate red): repair effect attempt 2 recorded (verification-repair, parent b06fde...), detail 'mounted read-only: the previous candidate ... and the gate evidence of attempt 1 (.../evidence/attempt-1)'. Second launch's room held the clean room, .repair/previous-candidate and .repair/gate-evidence-attempt-1 (gate.log, suite.log); neither directory nor any file in them writable (dr-xr-xr-x / r--); instruction named both as read-only.

items.name: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, and no fourth builder is launched
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: All-red stub: launched 3 times (n=1..3), no fourth; run failed, cycle at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted, gate-attempts 3.

items.name: Verdicts handed in are filed as given, and the run passes as its cycle passes
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: Handed in 01-001 pass 'booked', 01-002 fail 'judged by the main session' with r-1: file-verdicts and file-score effects recorded; measurement-filed passes 1 total 2 with those items and evidences; run passed, cycle passed.

items.name: An item the verdicts file does not name is Measurement's to record as unreached
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: R-14 hand-in with only 01-001 pass: measurement-filed items 01-002 verdict fail reason unreached (unreached 1), passes 1 of 2; run passed, cycle passed.

items.name: Verdicts for a run that does not exist are refused
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: Hand-in for R-9 (none): refused no-run; run-progress R-9 -> null.

items.name: Verdicts for a run whose gate never passed are refused
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: R-19 failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted: hand-in refused gate-not-passed; no file-verdicts effect; still failed (also R-22 with three red attempts: same).

items.name: A second verdicts file is refused, and no builder follows the verdicts
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: R-15: after the unknown-item verdicts failed the score stage (cycle failed at score, score-stage-failed), a second hand-in refused verdicts-already-handed-in; no regenerate/repair effect after the verdicts; builder launched only once for R-15.

items.name: Verdicts under a grader digest the run did not approve are refused
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: R-1 awaiting, digests [r-1]: hand-in with r-2 refused grader-not-approved; R-1 still awaiting-verdicts.

items.name: A verdicts file that is blank is refused, and nothing is filed
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: Blank verdicts file: refused verdicts-not-readable; R-1 still awaiting-verdicts, effects end at gate (no file-verdicts).

items.name: Verdicts Measurement refuses fail the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: R-15 hand-in 01-001 pass + 09-001 pass: file-verdicts refused unknown-item (measurement), fail-score-stage recorded (score-stage-failed); run failed, cycle at score for score-stage-failed; no builder launch after the verdicts.

items.name: A context that stops answering halts the run, and nothing is recorded for that effect
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: Wrapper around real measurement exits when asked measurement/derive-checklist: run halted, halt effect checklist reason context-did-not-respond; effects only stamp and pin (no checklist effect result).

items.name: A run that ended stays as it ended
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: R-10 (failed at fence) and R-33 (halted at checklist), plus R-12, R-8, R-9, R-16, R-17: run-progress re-read 5.0-86 s after each start responded is identical to the reading taken when it responded (effect results, relayed handoffs, status).

items.name: Reading a run's progress changes nothing
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: R-1 awaiting verdicts read twice: results identical (only JSON-RPC ids differ); still awaiting-verdicts; runs-to-advance [].
